content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required authorization was absent, and the payer’s 30-day retro-authorization window is closed; peer-to-peer is unavailable and the medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted. The balance was not adjudicated as deductible, so billing the patient would exceed the established contractual patient share, and no secondary payer exists. With the payer path exhausted and no collectible responsible party, the balance should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
